hero.title: Bitcoin wallets untouched for 10 years moved $40 million. Most avoided exchanges
hero.description: Six decade-old wallets moved $40 million this month, but Galaxy's data shows dormant coin activity at its lowest since 2022 and 2026 on pace for under half of last year's total.

latest.title: Mark Walter's insurer Delaware Life sees two banks pause sale of its products amid probes
latest.description: Walter's holding company earlier in the week said "there has been no fraud" at Delaware Life and its affiliated company, Clear Spring Life and Annuity.

latest.title: Ripple is preparing XRP Ledger for quantum computers before ‘Q-Day’ arrives
latest.description: An Anthropic model cut the work needed to break a leading post-quantum signature candidate by a factor of 67 million last month, while Bitcoin and Ethereum published their own migration plans this week.

latest.title: U.S. appeals court rules against prediction markets, sets up likely fight at Supreme Court
latest.description: The 9th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals ruled that sports-related event contracts are not swaps, contradicting a 3rd Circuit ruling from April.

latest.title: Meta's $17 billion settlement mandates new safeguards for kids—many are promising, says safety expert
latest.description: Following a major legal settlement, Instagram and Facebook users under age 18 will soon have a daily two-hour limit and won't be able to see reactions on posts.

latest.title: Trump announces deal with Venezuela to secure more than 65 billion barrels of oil reserves
latest.description: The U.S. struck a deal with Venezuela to get majority control of more than 65 billion barrels of oil reserves, Trump said in a social media post.

latest.title: Kalshi takes legal blow in court ruling confirming state powers over prediction markets
latest.description: This latest U.S. appeals court ruling sets up a rift between federal courts on event contracts, suggesting the U.S. Supreme Court may need to settle the matter.

latest.title: Bitcoin Rally Stalls, But Long-Term Sentiment Remains Bullish
latest.description: BTC gave back some of its gains after Fed Chair Kevin Warsh talked tough on inflation, but prediction market traders are still leaning bullish.

latest.title: Trump loses bid to transfer New York hush money case to federal court
latest.description: Trump's conviction in the hush money case relates to conduct that preceded the 2016 presidential election, which led to his first term in the White House.

latest.title: Bessent attacks Warren over yen intervention query, offers ‘Foreign Exchange for Dummies’ lesson
latest.description: Treasury has not disclosed how much yen it bought, the execution rate or the current value of the position, despite Warren’s requests for details.

latest.title: Meta Tests Robots to Handle Data Center Work
latest.description: The company says it needs more skilled workers as its AI infrastructure expands, but employees fear automation could reduce or eliminate some roles.

latest.title: CEO of buy now, pay later giant Affirm says high gas prices are hitting U.S. shoppers
latest.description: The national average price for gas is at $4.09 per gallon and was last below $3 on March 2.

latest.title: 2-year Treasury yield jumps as Warsh says Fed may 'have work to do'
latest.description: Investors assessed Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish message in his keynote address at Jackson Hole.

latest.title: Corn and wheat prices jump to highest prices in more than three years
latest.description: Corn and wheat futures have surged to their highest levels in more than three years. But the reasons for these recent rallies are notably different.

latest.title: Solana validators approve proposal to accelerate SOL disinflation
latest.description: The approved proposal doubles Solana’s annual disinflation rate from 15% to 30%, reducing future SOL issuance while leaving its long-term inflation target unchanged.

latest.title: XRP Treasury Company Gets One Step Closer to Listing on Nasdaq
latest.description: Evernorth has gained SEC clearance, teeing up a shareholder vote on its Nasdaq listing—while the firm's XRP stash sits well below what it paid for it.

latest.title: Stock traders warm up to Warsh as volatility index touches year-to-date low
latest.description: The Cboe Volatility Index (VIX), which measures the price of 30-day options on the S&P 500 Index, fell to as low as 14.1.

latest.title: US Cities Eye AI Data Center Limits as Study Flags Water Risks
latest.description: Austin is the latest city to consider restrictions as communities challenge the water and electricity demands of AI infrastructure.

latest.title: Apple hikes subscription prices for Apple TV and Apple One in the U.S.
latest.description: Apple raised prices for Apple Music by $1 per month in July, citing licensing costs.
